paragraphs.text: House Kavrel was one of the five powerful houses in Arathoxia , ruled by Tobias Kavrel . It ruled the Plains of Urlan , and its seat in Arathoxia was the Watchtower.

It was also known as House Pearl , after the white Mox whose location was never revealed. House Kavrel was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of Arathoxia as the first to fall, completely overrun along with its leader by Ravidel's Demonic Hordes , and then obliterated by a blast from the Planar Barge.
Tobias Kavrel was the human lord of House Kavrel in Arathoxia on Corondor . During Ravidel ’s invasion of Arathoxia , he was killed by the summoned demonic hordes .
